conditional_branches.conditions_in_words: The donor (Devon Gray) has paid at least as much in Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the tax year ending 5 April 2024 as the amount of Gift Aid claimed (25p per £1 donation), and a complete Gift Aid declaration is available.

The donor (Devon Gray) has not paid at least as much in Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the tax year ending 5 April 2024 as the amount of Gift Aid claimed, or no complete Gift Aid declaration is available.

justification: The donation of £95 from Devon Gray on 1 March 2026 is eligible for Gift Aid under E01, as it is from an individual and not through payroll giving, for goods/services, or as a benefit over a limit. However, the policy requires the donor to have paid at least as much in Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the tax year as the claimed Gift Aid (E04/E07), and a complete Gift Aid declaration (E05) is missing. The tax document covers the year ending 5 April 2024, which may not align with the tax year of the donation (2026), and no current-year donor tax evidence is available. Without confirmation of the donor's tax payment in the relevant tax year and a complete declaration, eligibility cannot be confirmed. Thus, more information is needed.
